sections.title: Ohio corporate income and franchise taxes

rows.label: Corporate income (franchise) tax
rows.value: None: Ohio phased out its corporation franchise tax in favor of the Commercial Activity Tax
rows.note: Phased out over report years 2006-2010; the franchise tax now applies only to a small number of special corporations, and banks pay a separate Financial Institutions Tax.

source.title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Corporation Franchise Tax (publication)

rows.label: Commercial Activity Tax (CAT) rate
rows.note: Gross-receipts tax on Ohio taxable gross receipts above the annual exclusion; applies to all business forms, not just corporations.

source.title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Commercial Activity Tax (CAT) (September 3, 2025)

rows.label: CAT annual exclusion
rows.note: For tax years 2025 and later only receipts above $6 million are taxed and smaller businesses owe nothing ($3 million in 2024). The annual minimum tax ended in 2024.

source.title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Commercial Activity Tax (CAT) (September 3, 2025)

sections.title: Ohio property tax: state rules

rows.label: Levied by
rows.value: School districts, counties, municipalities, townships and special service districts
rows.note: Taxable (assessed) value is 35% of market value; county auditors appraise property.

source.title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Property Tax - Real Property

rows.label: State oversight
rows.value: Ohio Department of Taxation, Division of Tax Equalization
rows.note: Oversees county auditors' six-year reappraisals and three-year updates using sales-ratio studies.

source.title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Property Tax - Real Property

rows.label: Limit on unvoted property tax (10-mill limitation)
rows.value: Unvoted levies may not exceed 1% of true value (10 mills on taxable value, about 0.35% of market value)
rows.note: Constitutional limit on 'inside' millage; voter-approved levies are on top.

source.title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Property Tax - Real Property

rows.label: Homestead exemption (seniors, disabled and certain survivors)
rows.note: Shields up to $29,000 of market value for qualifying owners (income limit $40,000 for tax year 2025); amount is indexed for inflation each year, so the 2026 figure may differ.

source.title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Property Tax - Real Property
Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Property Tax - Real Property

sections.note: Property tax is levied locally; these are the rules the state sets. Each row has its own official source.

sections.title: Ohio real estate transfer tax

rows.label: Real property conveyance fee (state-mandated)
rows.value: 1 mill ($1 per $1,000 of value transferred), in all 88 counties
rows.note: Mandatory fee set by state law; revenue goes to the county general fund.

source.title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Real Property Conveyance Fees

rows.label: Mandatory conveyance fee rate
rows.note: Same fee expressed as a rate.

source.title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Real Property Conveyance Fees

rows.label: County permissive transfer fee
rows.value: Up to 3 additional mills ($3 per $1,000); every county levies 1 to 3 mills
rows.note: Counties may set a lower rate for homestead-exemption property. Total can reach 4 mills.

source.title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Real Property Conveyance Fees

rows.label: Who pays
rows.note: Paid at the time of transfer.
